sources.note: Administrator of record by facility license, 1997 onward.

sources.title: Connecticut DPH chronic and convalescent nursing home roster (eLicense export)
State Licenses and Credentials, data.ct.gov (ngch-56tr), Nursing Home Administrator
sources.note: License status, issue and expiration dates.

sources.title: CMS Payroll-Based Journal staffing history (Q4 2017 onward)
sources.note: Facility staffing during each tenure, through the CCN match.

caveats: Records come from public Connecticut DPH license roster exports and the public CT license dataset. They show the administrator of record a facility reported to DPH, which can lag actual changes.
Facility conditions during this period reflect many factors and are not a measure of the administrator's performance.
Listing is not an allegation of wrongdoing.
Open roles are open as of the source date; they do not confirm current employment.
People are matched by license number only, never by name.
Coverage: the DPH history covers the 188 chronic and convalescent nursing homes licensed when the data was downloaded. Service at homes that have since closed is not included.
Staffing context comes from CMS Payroll-Based Journal data, which starts in Q4 2017.
corrections_notice: Records come from public state and federal sources. To report an error, email hello@danbeem.xyz.
